pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit simultaneous duplicate order entry within 60 seconds; secondary scaling into an active position is only authorized after a minimum +$4.00 unrealized profit cushion and a confirmed structural higher-low/lower-high.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandate a multi-timeframe ATR volatility filter and order-flow imbalance check; block execution if spread exceeds 0.35 and enforce a mandatory 5-pip buffer away from exact integer psychological handle levels for stop placement.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing sentinel harvests once floating profit crosses +$5.00 to prevent erosion back to breakeven or minor loss.
